about: Every screen name scripts/store-screenshots-android.sh maps captures for Tenshu Maps — Android only so far (no iOS walk), so `captured` (the iOS list) is empty and `android.captured` is the list. Maps cannot make a place itself: it shows the places Timeline's Takeout import made, so the run walks Timeline first (docs/how-to/store-screenshots.md §8.2). Adding a capture means adding it here.

android.about: The Android pipeline (scripts/store-screenshots-android.sh maps, walk in scripts/lib/android_shots.py) captures these on a 1080x2400 phone AVD, light only, keyed android/phone/<lang>/NN-screen.

01-places.shows: Your places: the places from Timeline, each with its visit count

02-place.shows: One place: its spot on the offline basemap and its visits
